title: How Hungry is AI? Benchmarking Energy, Water, and Carbon Footprint of LLM Inference

live_model.id_in_text: GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1 nano, GPT-5, o3-mini (multiple)
live_model.evidence: "DGX A100 was estimated for GPT-4o mini, GPT-4 Turbo, and GPT-4..."; "Our framework estimates 0.42 Wh for a short GPT-4o prompt" -- energy-modeling, not a task claim

prompt.note: No task prompt exists; the paper estimates energy/water/carbon footprints from published specs and hardware assumptions, not from a model's answer to a prompt.

claim.metric: none of the relevant type: the numbers are environmental-footprint ESTIMATES (Wh/query, annual water/carbon), not an accuracy metric tied to a prompt+answer

data.source: Published model/hardware specs, scaled usage assumptions (e.g., 1 billion daily queries), and third-party benchmark throughput numbers

notes: This paper is an environmental-impact estimation study (energy/water/carbon per query and at scale), not an empirical task-accuracy benchmark; it references many live and dead OpenAI snapshots (gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o, gpt-4o mini, gpt-4.1 nano, gpt-5, o3-mini) throughout, but none is tied to a printed prompt + reported task-performance number of the kind this triage targets. Not a fit for prompt-level reproduction regardless of model availability.
